name: MEPDrawingProduction
description: Produce the MEP drawing set: tag first (the annotation pass and the rich tags read the tokens), then produce cropped plans from the Scope Box Planner's area boxes and from STING:: scope boxes, and whole-floor plans per level; then match lines (they quote sheet numbers, so they follow the sheets), then panel schedules. Production takes its inputs from each step's params instead of a dialog: with none given, each M, E, P, FP and MG discipline that has anything modelled gets the one plan type its PLAN routes to (the set the dialogs pre-tick), on the levels it occupies, as views and sheets; STING:: boxes are produced only when bound to an MEP drawing type. Re-runs reuse views and sheets matched by stamp, so it is safe to run again after model changes.

steps.label: Tag and combine the whole project (ISO 19650 tokens and tags the drawings annotate with)
Token confidence audit (elements that fell back to a default ZONE or LOC)

Produce MEP plans from the STING-AREA:: area boxes (runs only when the project has some; boxes the saved Scope Box Planner plan does not list, or all of them when no plan is saved, are produced from their name with the routed MEP plan types)
Produce from STING::<type>::<level>::<zone> scope boxes bound to an M/E/P/FP/MG drawing type (runs only when there are some)

Produce whole-floor MEP plans per level (runs only when the project has no area boxes; the routed plan type of each modelled M/E/P/FP/MG discipline, on the levels it occupies, unless params.drawingTypes names them)
Match lines between adjacent and overlapping scope boxes (same drawing type, same level)
Build / refresh the STING panel schedule templates
Create the panel schedules (rule-based template pick, drawing-type stamp, ELC_PNL_* fill)

Panel circuit schedules on sheets: one per board, each on its own elec-panel-schedule-A3 sheet (re-runs reuse them; the native panel schedules still need dragging — Revit 2024+ cannot place them by API)

_notes: Step params: drawingTypes (comma list of ids; default: for each M, E, P, FP, MG discipline with anything modelled, the plan type its PLAN routes to — not every MEP Plan type, which would add the presentation, technical, fabrication, 1:500 and healthcare variants — produced only on the levels that discipline occupies; for STING:: boxes, the boxes bound to an MEP type; for area boxes, the saved plan's types, and the routed default for a box the plan does not list), levels (comma list of level names; default all), output ('Views and sheets' | 'Views only'), duplicateOption ('Duplicate' | 'DuplicateAsDependent' | 'DuplicateWithDetailing'), packageId.
An unknown drawing type or level, or an unreadable output / duplicateOption, fails the step with the reason in the workflow report.

The production route is chosen by condition: area boxes when the project has STING-AREA:: boxes (a saved Scope Box Planner plan is not required — a hand-made STING-AREA::<area>[::<level>] box is produced on its ::level, or on every level it reaches), whole-floor per level otherwise, and STING:: boxes whenever any exist.
